note: Chapter 1 is keyed from 'steals the ball' (the steal from Lowton) through 'runs straight at', 'Tarkowski steps up', 'Pulisic darts past', 'into the box' to 'goal' (the ball in the net): keep the pause at '...' so the run plays near real time. Pulisic is pronounced 'puh-LISS-ick'; Tarkowski 'tar-KOV-skee'.

chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Burnley versus Chelsea, 2019. Christian Pulisic steals the ball and runs straight at the defence. Tarkowski steps up. Pulisic darts past, into the box... goal!

chapters.label: Slow motion
chapters.text: Slow motion: he attacks Tarkowski head on. The defender has to decide, so he pushes him wide. Pulisic reacts and darts past.

chapters.label: The finish
chapters.text: Then a low shot with his left foot, across goal, through Ben Mee's legs, past Nick Pope!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: run straight at defenders. They have to decide, then you react and go past.
